brief:
Hamas condemned Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir after he posted a video showing himself threatening to kill Palestinian prisoner Hassan Salameh, Middle East Eye reported. The video prompted a sharp response from the militant group, which called out the far-right minister's actions.

Ben Gvir, who holds the security portfolio in Israel's government, appeared in the footage making threats against the detainee.
dek: Hamas hits back at Ben Gvir after video shows him threatening Palestinian detainee Hamas slammed Israeli far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir after he posted a video of himself threatening to kill Palestinian prisoner Hassan Salameh.
title: Hamas condemns Ben Gvir for video threatening to kill Palestinian detainee
